documents.title: Component Alternative: Capacitor C100 Mitigation Plan
documents.description: Approved mitigation plan for replacing capacitor C100 with alternative part CAP-X200 due to supply chain shortage.

chunks.chunk_text: Mitigation plan for capacitor C100: Replace with alternative part CAP-X200. The CAP-X200 has equivalent electrical specifications (100uF, 25V, +/-10% tolerance) and is available from secondary supplier Acme Electronics with a lead time of 2 weeks.

Risk assessment for C100 substitution: The CAP-X200 alternative has been validated through qualification testing per IPC-A-610 Class 2 standards. No design changes are required. Rework procedure documented in WI-2024-045.
